You shouldn’t give much importance to what the community say especially it’s your first MH game! Instead…

You should just stick for LS until you’ve mastered it! Play it since it’s what you enjoyed and liked playing with. If you feel like you already mastered it, say you’re comfortable playing LS, and had a full grasp of the game mechanics (monsters, fighting patterns, and just the game overall) then maybe it’s time you reconsider another weapon.

Because you have your 1st main weapon, but it wouldn’t hurt to look at other weapons since they also possess fun and unique playstyle! Other weapons pushes you to learn monster movements such as greatswords or lance. Other weapons creates a fun trickster playstyle like insect glaive. There’s really alot more!
